source.title: MerlothPark_morning_ambiance.wav
source.author: reinsamba
source.prepare: python scripts/sound-clean.py <file> savanna_day_matched.wav --match <the mod's old ambient/outside/savanna_day.ogg> 35.79, then --source savanna_day_matched.wav
source.notes: 44.1 kHz stereo, 214 s. The old loop was 30 s pieced together from around 36 s, its tone reshaped: matched again with --match, a 60 s loop at 24 kHz for about the old size. From 81 s: earlier stretches have low thumps (handling or wind, under 90 Hz) at 34, 52, 60 and 79.5-80.2 s.
